# false

Exit unsuccessfully through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/false
```

Produce no output and exit 1. Ordinary arguments are ignored.

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Standalone --help and --version print metadata and exit 0.
